ratings.notes: Judgemental can imply unfairness or purity-based judgment; accepting implies tolerance. Also relates to general moral character.
Deviant can relate to disrespect for norms/traditions (Authority), impurity, or general immorality.
Gossiping can be disloyal; confidential implies loyalty/trust. Gossiping is also generally immoral.
Official relates to authority/rules; backdoor implies defiance of authority or improper conduct.
Crafty can imply dishonesty or trickery, a general vice.
Relates to hierarchy and roles within authority.
Independent relates to freedom/autonomy (Liberty); codependent implies a lack of liberty.
Family is a key ingroup, relating to Loyalty.
Relates to cleanliness and order, aspects of Purity.
Tame implies control/obedience (Authority, Purity); wild implies lack of control.
Prestigious relates to status/respect (Authority); disreputable implies lack of respect or general bad character.
Scandalous implies indecency/immorality; proper implies decency/adherence to norms (Purity, Authority, General).
Relates to hierarchy and roles within authority.
Relates to adherence to/defiance of traditional norms (Authority) and conventional/natural order (Purity).
